text:
sasha: Did a quick accessibility smoke on the new dashboard panels. Found 4 small issues: (1) feature toggles lose visible focus in Chrome when using keyboard-only, (2) compact success/error chips fail contrast at 11px, (3) alert rail announces twice on VoiceOver, (4) sortable headers aren't exposing aria-sort.

diego: thanks — can you paste short repro steps?

sasha: repro: mac Chrome 116 + VoiceOver, Windows Chrome + NVDA. Steps: open Projects > tab across header, try keyboard toggle on the feature switch (no visible ring), check project list chips (11px small labels), trigger an alert from the build monitor — VO reads message twice, and use keyboard to sort "Name" column — NVDA doesn't read sort direction.

rachel: i reproduced the double announce — looks like we have both role=alert and an aria-live parent. Also the toggle control is a div[role="switch"] with CSS removing outline. We should switch to a native input or ensure :focus-visible shows a clear ring.

diego: plan: (A) replace div-switch with <button role="switch" aria-checked> or native checkbox hidden, (B) add :focus-visible box-shadow using --a11y-focus token, not outline:none, (C) consolidate live regions to a single sr-only aria-live container and set textContent (replace), (D) add aria-sort to <th> with values "none|ascending|descending" and update on click.

a11y-bot: axe results -> color-contrast x2, duplicate-live-announcement x1, focus-visible-missing x1, table-headers-aria x1. Suggest minimal token changes + single live region pattern.

sasha: action items: diego -> small PR for switch+focus+aria-sort; rachel -> voiceover/NVDA verification on preview; i'll update Figma to call out focus token and chip token for compact sizes. Target: patch release.

diego: i'll open PR today with before/after screenshots and reproducer steps.

rachel: will test the preview and check that alerts announce once and table announces sort state.

sasha: thanks team! small fixes but big accessibility wins. :white_check_mark:
